rationale: The optimal solution minimizes diesel cost by maximizing the total energy discharged from the battery over the horizon. The total discharge is limited by the minimum state-of-charge (SOC) constraint at the end of the final period. The maximum total discharge that respects the final SOC >= 6 MWh is 10 MWh. The chosen schedule `[0, 0, 10]` MW achieves this total discharge, resulting in the minimum possible total cost of $9435.00. No PV curtailment or load shedding is required.
